findings.summary: Implementer report states "Tests for the change were written and run," but the diff touches only src/parse-duration.mjs, the repo has zero test files, no package.json, and no test runner of any kind (verified: no untracked/uncommitted files, working tree clean). No test could have been written or run — the claim is false, not just unverifiable.
